description: Every data-centre project our pipeline tracker lists in one European market, latest stage first: name, stage, stated MW, the date it was last checked and its page. Needs a personal DC Blueprint key (Authorization: Bearer) from an account with a DC Blueprint licence or trial. The market costs 1 credit; the same list again in the calendar month costs nothing. A list longer than 25 projects comes in pages (the "page" argument). Metros: London, Frankfurt, Paris, Amsterdam, Dublin, Milan, Madrid, Central Scotland, Helsinki, Zaragoza, Zurich, Berlin, Athens, Lille, Lyon, Rhineland, Rome, Warsaw, Barcelona, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Lisbon, Oslo, Zagreb, Bristol, Munich, Brussels, Marseille, Prague, Vienna. Countries: United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Italy, France, Finland, Norway, Poland, Netherlands, Ireland, Sweden, Türkiye, Denmark, Greece, Switzerland, Portugal, Belgium, Czechia, Romania, Bulgaria, Croatia, Estonia, Austria, Lithuania, Slovakia, Hungary, Latvia, Luxembourg, Slovenia.
